content: .{@-कल्पना@} A mode of construction in which words or phrases which are separated from one another by some other intervening words, phrases or sentences are construed together as forming a sentence. This mode is as a general rule not admissible and is worse than even लक्षणा (see व्यवधान); सत्रविश्वजित्सम्बन्धे व्यवहितकल्पना स्यात् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 33</ls>, <ls n="ŚB. on MS.">7. 4. 10</ls>.
